title: Visiting a Sick Friend
paragraphs: Fatimah mendengar dari rekan kerja bahwa temannya, Aisha, sedang sakit dan sudah beberapa hari tidak masuk kerja. Ia merasa khawatir, jadi ia memutuskan untuk mengunjungi apartemen Aisha setelah shalat Asar dalam perjalanan pulangnya.

Ia membawa sup hangat dan beberapa kata yang menenangkan. "Bagaimana perasaanmu hari ini?" tanya Fatimah lembut sambil duduk di samping sofa. "Sedikit lebih baik sekarang, terima kasih sudah datang," jawab Aisha dengan senyum lelah.

Mereka mengobrol sebentar tentang pekerjaan, keluarga, dan hal-hal sederhana sehari-hari. Fatimah menawarkan bantuan berbelanja bahan makanan sampai Aisha benar-benar pulih. Sebelum pergi, ia mendoakan kesehatan dan kesembuhan cepat temannya dengan tenang.

Aisha merasa benar-benar tersentuh karena rekan kerjanya yang sibuk meluangkan waktu di malam harinya untuk menjenguknya. Kunjungan singkat seperti ini, pikirnya, berarti jauh lebih banyak daripada pesan apa pun yang dikirim dari jarak jauh.
answerKey: Fatimah hears from a colleague that her friend Aisha has been sick and has missed several days of work. She feels concerned, so she decides to visit Aisha's apartment after Asr prayer on her way home. She brings some warm soup and a few kind words. "How are you feeling today?" Fatimah asks softly as she sits beside the sofa. "A little better now, thank you for coming," Aisha answers with a tired smile. They talk for a while about work, family, and simple daily matters. Fatimah offers to help with grocery shopping until Aisha recovers fully. Before leaving, she makes a quiet du'a for her friend's health and speedy recovery. Aisha feels genuinely touched that a busy colleague took time out of her evening to check on her. A short visit like this, she thinks, means far more than any message sent from a distance.
